title: Understanding Drag Force
text: The drag force on a car is proportional to the square of its speed. This means if the speed of the car doubles, the drag force increases by a factor of four.

title: Calculating the Factor of Increase
text: To find the factor by which the drag force increases, calculate the square of the ratio of the final speed to the initial speed.

title: Calculate the Speed Ratio
text: Calculate the ratio of the final speed ($$110\,\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$) to the initial speed ($$65\,\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$).

title: Square the Speed Ratio
text: Square the ratio you calculated to find the factor by which the drag force increases.
